body:
cardigan weather.

that is a starter chip, word for word, and this is what it actually handed back:

never grow up (speak now) — a lullaby to a child that turns out to be a lullaby to herself, alone in a new apartment.
seven (folklore) — two little girls plotting pirate escapes, remembered decades on.
tim mcgraw (debut) — a goodbye that just wants to be remembered when the right song comes on.
new year’s day (reputation) — after twelve tracks of armor, she just wants whoever holds the trash bag.
we were happy (fearless) — cataloging the golden middle of a love, because the happiness is what hurts to recall.

five songs, five different eras, from two words.

tap Mood at the top of the page and try your own.

longlivets.com/?utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=mood-chat

📷 the 63rd grammys, march 2021 — the night folklore won album of the year. kevin mazur/getty images for the recording academy. swipe to see the chip in mood.
why: Calendar slot 2026-08-16 23:00Z IG, launch:mood-chat day +4 (example output), hook = the chip label VERBATIM as the first line, exactly as the calendar and mood-starters.ts require (approved copy, never reworded). The result is REAL, not invented: the chip path is deterministic and model-free, and this exact vector was run against the live endpoint at www.longlivets.com/api/mood on 2026-08-11, returning Never Grow Up / seven / Tim McGraw / New Year’s Day / We Were Happy in that order, with the one-liners quoted from the response. Every returned song sits in a scored era — nothing from evermore, Midnights, TTPD or TLOAS, per the coverage-gap rule. MEDIA, disclosed: this reuses /social/library/mood-chat-screen.png, four days after the 08-12 announce, because the library has only two Mood assets and the ideal image (a screenshot of this actual result) cannot be captured in a queue-only PR. Recommend Tree/Growth capture a real result screenshot for the next Mood beat. DEPLOY DEPENDENCY: needs #1903 deployed. | 2026-08-12 Taylor-photo standard (issue #2031, Joey directive): attached a real credited photograph of Taylor from the repo corpus (apps/web/lib/longlive/lenses.ts), rehosted under /social/library/photos/. Campaign renamed to a STORY-UNIQUE value: findPostedDuplicate treats same platform+campaign as an already-posted duplicate, so the old thematic bucket campaigns (heartbeat:*) would have false-skipped every post in a bucket after its first one landed. Rescheduled after the Taylor-photo set; upgraded to a carousel (folklore-era photo tile — the post is about the "cardigan weather" chip — with the Mood screenshot as slide 2) so its tile does not repeat mood-chat-screen.png days after the announce post.
